verdict.rationale: A guided first-time setup walkthrough is a fair question for a SaaS work-management tool like Jira, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no onboarding wizard, guided tour, or setup walkthrough. Pre-built project templates help users start quickly but are an adjacent feature, not a guided walkthrough.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time
